record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: Four units declare KING_SHIELD: Honedge (1 star), Doublade (2 stars), Aegislash and Aegislash Blade (3 stars, both with passive AEGISLASH). The strategy is shared; the form-change branch only runs for units whose passive is AEGISLASH.
record.summary: The caster gains protect for 1500 ms (if it is not already protected and not enraged) and a self shield of 10/20/40/80 by stars (requested; applied after Big Eater Belt, AP, crit, enraged halving and rounding). It then swaps cells with the farthest targettable enemy (forced displacement, so it does nothing if either side cannot be moved). Units with passive AEGISLASH also toggle form after 1500 ms: Aegislash becomes Blade (requested +10 attack, -5 DEF, -5 SPE_DEF) and Blade returns to Aegislash (requested reverse). The applied amounts depend on Big Eater Belt, which also scales negative changes the holder causes to itself, so the two directions need not cancel (see the statChange effect).

declaredRaw.label: requested amounts (raw); applied amounts depend on Big Eater Belt and the floors

effects.scaling: each delayed callback calls addAttack / addDefense / addSpecialDefense on the caster with the caster itself as source, apBoost 0 and crit false, so there is no AP or crit scaling
effects.resolution: the requested amounts go through the stat adders. applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff first multiplies by 1.25 and rounds with mode 'down' (Math.floor) when the value is positive OR when it is negative and comes from a caster on the holder's own team (here the holder itself): for a Big Eater Belt holder +10 becomes +12, -5 becomes -7, +5 becomes +6 and -10 becomes -13 (floor of a negative number goes further from zero). applyTwistBandBuff then changes only negative values from another team or the environment, so it does nothing here. Floors afterwards: attack at least 1, DEF and SPE_DEF at least 0. Pinned-helper probe (AP 0, no crit, no floor reached; holder ATK / DEF / SPE_DEF 30 / 20 / 20): without the belt Aegislash->Blade gives 40 / 15 / 15 and Blade->Aegislash returns to 30 / 20 / 20; with Big Eater Belt Aegislash->Blade gives 42 / 13 / 13 and Blade->Aegislash gives 29 / 19 / 19, so the inverse changes do not cancel (net -1 ATK, -1 DEF, -1 SPE_DEF per round trip). The applied value therefore differs from the requested one whenever the belt or a floor applies.

statusEffects.effect: attacks and ability damage against the unit are blocked; heals skipped

starBehavior.note: Only the shield amount is star dependent; protect duration and form deltas are fixed. The 4-star entry (80) is the fallback.

record.positionalConditions: Movement targets the farthest targettable enemy by distanceM; it is skipped when none exists or when either unit cannot be moved.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: Two modes for units with passive AEGISLASH: from AEGISLASH the form delta toward Blade, from AEGISLASH_BLADE the delta back. The form check happens when the cast runs, not when the callback runs, and the callback body does not re-check the form: a cast made before the earlier 1500 ms callback has run queues another callback of the same direction, so several callbacks can be queued at once and each applies its full delta. Probe (Big Eater Belt, AP 0): two casts before the first callback runs queue two Aegislash->Blade callbacks and leave ATK / DEF / SPE_DEF at 54 / 6 / 6 after both have run (30 + 12 + 12; 20 - 7 - 7), with the name set to the blade form twice. Whether this can happen in a real fight (cooldown and PP gating of two casts within 1500 ms) was not traced.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: shield 10/20/40/80; protect 1500 ms; form deltas +10/-5/-5 (and reverse). Applied: shield after Big Eater Belt, AP, crit, enraged halving and rounding; protect only if not already active and not enraged; stat deltas after Big Eater Belt (which scales positive deltas and the caster's own negative deltas, floor rounding, so +10/-5/-5 becomes +12/-7/-7 and the reverse -10/+5/+5 becomes -13/+6/+6) and the stat floors.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: How the shield and protect interact with handleDamage beyond the cited protect branch (shield absorption order, takenDamage) was not traced; see knowledge core-mechanics §A
